name: Potion of Diminution
summary: A potion that shrinks you as the reduce effect of Enlarge/Reduce.

stats.effect:
When you drink this potion, you gain the "reduce" effect of the *{ref:spell/enlarge-reduce}* spell for 1d4 hours (no Concentration required).

The red in the potion's liquid continuously contracts to a tiny bead and then expands to color the clear liquid around it. Shaking the bottle fails to interrupt this process.
